citations.claim: At step 203 E is red during NS yellow with no emergency active
At step 204 E is green with emergency active, 0s all-red, violating clearance

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=204; otherwise identical. Without preemption the normal NS yellow -> all-red -> EW green sequence is followed, so no clearance violation.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=204 forces an immediate switch from NS yellow (step 203) to EW green (step 204), skipping the required 3s all-red clearance. Normal cycle would go NS green -> NS yellow -> all-red -> EW green, but the emergency handler sets EW green directly with 0s of all-red.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 3 s)

vision_note: In steps 201-202 one axis holds green while the other holds red, and in step 203 the green axis turns yellow. In step 204 the cross axis is already green with no all-red gap in between.
